cohort.source_morphology_reason: asymmetric H I extent and stellar disk; close physical pair with NGC4302; interaction may explain lopsidedness
strongly disturbed stellar disk with shells and banana-shaped isophotes; gravitational interaction or collision indicated
extended one-sided H I tail, compressed opposite edge, and disturbed stellar disk; ram pressure plus gravitational interaction candidate
weak tightly wound optical structure with no obvious tidal or ongoing ICM interaction reported
H I distribution reported symmetric and regular with no indication of ongoing interaction; central bar retained as explicit caveat
H I morphology reported fairly regular and symmetric with no signature of ongoing ram pressure or tidal interaction

cohort_rule: exact named 3 disturbed plus 3 quiet morphology controls; no substitution after velocity opening

construction.sideband_identity: an in-plane morphology mode m enters line-of-sight velocity at k=m-1 and k=m+1; retain k=m+1
construction.radial_support: four fixed equal-width annuli over 0.20 <= R/R25 <= 1.00
construction.source_template: per-annulus normalized H I moment-0 m=1 cosine/sine coefficient and its single global quadrature companion
construction.nuisance: per-annulus {constant, cos(theta), sin(theta)} plus frozen center/PA/inclination finite-difference tangents when supported
construction.score: cross-validated held-out-sector SSE reduction of nuisance+matched template relative to nuisance alone
construction.primary_contrast: mean matched-minus-wrong specificity in disturbed minus quiet controls
construction.inference: exact one-sided 3-of-6 role-label permutation; smallest attainable p is 0.05
construction.success_gate: positive primary contrast, exact p <= 0.05, and positive disturbed median specificity

cube_reduction_freeze.emission_seed: positive emission above 3 sigma in at least two adjacent channels
cube_reduction_freeze.mask_growth: one spectral channel and one image pixel after adjacency seed
cube_reduction_freeze.sampling: one sample per geometric-mean synthesized-beam diameter on a fixed image grid

hard_stops: any missing or changed named cube
fewer than eight occupied sectors or 24 beam-independent samples in any annulus
geometry tangent consumes the target span
claim_boundary: source-frozen conventional 2D morphology-sensitivity preregistration; not a Tau endpoint, parent-loss measurement, gravity correction, dark-matter alternative, or physical validation
